howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照你定义的函数（工具）来执行任务：先规划要调用哪个工具，然后等你执行完并返回结果，再继续下一步，直到任务完成。
howto.when: 当你需要 Claude 获取实时数据（如天气、数据库查询）、执行有副作用的操作（如发送邮件、创建文件），或进行多步推理时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下北京的当前天气。
先搜索最新的 AI 新闻，然后总结给我。
say.note: Claude 会依次调用搜索工具和总结工具。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will follow your defined functions (tools) to execute tasks: it plans which tool to call, waits for you to execute and return results, then continues until the task is complete.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need Claude to fetch real-time data (e.g., weather, database queries), perform side effects (e.g., send email, create files), or conduct multi-step reasoning.

say_en.text: Check the current weather in Beijing for me.
say_en.note: Claude will call the get_current_weather tool and return the result.

say_en.text: First search for the latest AI news, then summarize it for me.
say_en.note: Claude will sequentially call search and summarization tools.
